# HillClimbAnything

> A noise-aware referee for agent-driven optimisation. A coding agent proposes changes to a project; the `hca` CLI measures each change against the last kept version in randomised blocks, keeps it only if it beats the measured noise (exact one-sided signed-rank test at 1% per try, plus at least half the declared useful effect), and confirms the cumulative gain against the original on held-out data. Python 3.11+, no dependencies, Linux/WSL. It never calls an LLM.

Use it when someone wants to make a number better through repeated experiments (latency, render time, build time, frame time, cost, eval accuracy), or asks whether an improvement is real or noise.

Workflow: `hca quick -- <cmd>` (noise and detectable effect, no setup) → write `hca.toml` (editable paths, frozen evaluator, objective command printing `METRIC name=value` or item JSON, direction, useful_effect) → `hca init` → edit only editable paths → `hca try -m "change and mechanism"` (exit 0 keep, 1 revert, 2 invalid/void/refused) → `hca confirm` every few keeps (only confirmed gains count) → `hca report`.

Exit codes: `hca try` 0 keep, 1 revert, 2 invalid/void/refused, 3 usage, 4 internal error; `hca confirm` 0 pass, 1 fail (rolled back), 2 inconclusive/refused.

Do not use it when there is no repeatable command that prints the number, or for remote paid runs (the skill covers the method for those; there is no tooling yet). Tested on Linux and WSL with Claude Code; macOS and native Windows are untested.

Rules for agents: never edit frozen files, `.hca/`, `~/.hca` or `hca.toml`; never commit yourself (HCA commits keeps); no caches keyed on benchmark content or special-casing of inputs; report only confirmed results with their bound and the number of tries.

## Install

- Try without installing: `uvx --from git+https://github.com/JaiS1/HillClimbAnything hca quick -- <cmd>`
- Install the CLI: `uv tool install git+https://github.com/JaiS1/HillClimbAnything` (or `pipx install git+https://github.com/JaiS1/HillClimbAnything`), then `hca setup` to copy the agent skill to `~/.claude/skills/hca` and `~/.agents/skills/hca` (it shows its plan first; `hca setup --uninstall` removes it)
- Claude Code plugin instead of `hca setup`: `/plugin marketplace add JaiS1/HillClimbAnything` then `/plugin install hca@hillclimbanything` (install the CLI too)
- Skill source: [SKILL.md](https://github.com/JaiS1/HillClimbAnything/blob/main/skills/hca/SKILL.md)

## Evidence

- [Showcase: Python-Markdown render time -53.8% confirmed, output identical](https://github.com/JaiS1/HillClimbAnything/blob/main/showcases/python-markdown/README.md)
- [Phase 0 calibration: raw best-score keeps 17-55% of no-op changes; HCA's test <= 1%](https://github.com/JaiS1/HillClimbAnything/blob/main/spikes/phase0/RESULT.md)
